description: This file contains mock class definitions for various components of a shell or windowing system, mainly used for unit testing purposes. It mocks classes like RDKShell implementation, event handling, logging, composed system controls, and application management.

classes.name: RDKShellImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for RDKShell implementation, used to test code interacting with RDKShell's core functionalities.

classes.name: RdkShellApiImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for RdkShell API implementation, providing mock methods for system RAM info, memory monitoring, application easter eggs, and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: LoggerImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for logging functionalities within RdkShell, allowing tests to simulate enabling/disabling flushing and checking flush state.

classes.name: RdkShellEventImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for system event handling, covering application lifecycle events, device warnings, and user interactions.

classes.name: CompositorImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for composing window/application interface controls, including visibility, z-order, input handling, and display properties.

methods.name: keyCodeFromWayland
methods.description: Mocks the mapping from Wayland key codes to internal key codes.

methods.name: addEasterEgg
methods.description: Mocks adding an easter egg configuration.

methods.name: removeEasterEgg
methods.description: Mocks removing an easter egg by name.

methods.name: getEasterEggs
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of current easter eggs.

methods.name: microseconds
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of time in microseconds.

methods.name: milliseconds
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of time in milliseconds.

methods.name: seconds
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of time in seconds.
